rollup.detail: READY to promote: every included release-readiness check passed on this build/host.

checks.summary: All committed deployment example files validated (structure + no-secret invariants).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm deploy:examples:check` to see which blueprint is missing, malformed, or carries a credential-shaped literal, and fix it before promoting.

checks.summary: The daemon refuses to fabricate work, rejects bad flags, reports clean guardrails, and verifies lifecycle policy offline — all with the expected exit codes.
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:smoke` to see which honest-refusal or lifecycle assertion regressed; a mismatch means the daemon's failure modes are no longer truthful.

checks.summary: No required native engine is missing on the gate host (or none is required).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:engines` on the ACTUAL worker image/host: a required engine (opted in via a require flag) is missing. This gate's host may differ from the deployed image, so this is advisory — confirm on the image build.

checks.summary: worker:ops-check resolved the healthy snapshot fixture to a healthy verdict (exit 0).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:ops-check --file=<healthy snapshot> --json`: the healthcheck no longer classifies a healthy snapshot as healthy, so its verdict cannot be trusted.

checks.summary: worker:ops-check resolved the lifecycle-drift snapshot fixture to a critical verdict (exit 4).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:ops-check --file=<critical snapshot> --json`: the healthcheck failed to flag a critical (lifecycle-drift) snapshot, so it could pass a broken stack as healthy.

checks.summary: worker:ops-bundle composed the healthy ops-check fixture to a healthy rollup (exit 0).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:ops-bundle --ops-check=<healthy result> --json`: the aggregator no longer composes a healthy input to a healthy rollup.

checks.summary: worker:ops-bundle composed the critical ops-check fixture to a critical rollup (exit 4).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:ops-bundle --ops-check=<critical result> --json`: the aggregator failed to surface a critical composed signal, so it could pass a broken stack.

checks.summary: worker:cleanup-pipeline resolved a clean export with no backend wired to the honest 'cannot prove absence' band (exit 2), not a false clean pass.
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:cleanup-pipeline --file=<clean export> --now=<epoch>`: the pipeline no longer reports the honest 'unknown' band without a wired backend — a regression toward a false clean pass.

checks.summary: worker:cleanup-pipeline resolved a present-but-tombstoned export to a composite breach (exit 4).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:cleanup-pipeline --file=<tombstoned export> --now=<epoch>`: the pipeline failed to fail-closed on an unsafe (present-but-tombstoned) export.

checks.summary: worker:daemon --lifecycle-verify accepted a matching observed export as verified (exit 0).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:daemon --lifecycle-verify --provider=aws-s3 --versioned --observed=<matching export>`: lifecycle verification no longer accepts a matching policy.

checks.summary: worker:daemon --lifecycle-verify flagged a weaker/drifted observed export as invalid (exit 4).
checks.remediation: Re-run `pnpm worker:daemon --lifecycle-verify --provider=aws-s3 --versioned --observed=<drifted export>`: lifecycle verification failed to flag a drifted (weaker) policy, so retention drift could ship unnoticed.

guidance: Run the changed-file no-secret / no-NUL scan separately before promoting: this gate does not diff your working tree for credential-shaped literals or stray NUL bytes (the committed deployment blueprints are secret-scanned by the deploy-examples check, but your uncommitted changes are not).
Validate real cloud state out of band: bucket lifecycle rules, object deletion, queue/broker health, and CDN state are not observable from this offline gate.
Run this gate on the same build artifact you intend to promote; a `pass` certifies the evidence on THIS build/host, not a later rebuild.
caveats: This is a PRE-DEPLOY EVIDENCE gate: it RUNS existing content-free worker checks and folds their exit codes into one promotion verdict. It is not itself a new proof, and it does not perform the promotion.

It is local, offline, and read-only: it makes no network call and reads no provider export, secret, bucket, or object. It cannot validate real cloud state, bucket lifecycle correctness, deletion of bytes, or CDN state.

It reads only each check's process exit code and discards every byte of the check's output, so no locator, secret, or document content can enter a report — but that also means a report proves only what an exit code proves.

A `pass` verdict means the evidence gathered HERE shows no blocker — not that every out-of-band concern (real load, data migration, legal retention, provider quotas, secrets management) is resolved. Those remain operator-owned.
It is not malware scanning, sanitization, authentication, or authorization of any request, and it deletes, uploads, or mutates nothing.
